parameters.content:
## Discovery Ingest
Every 3h, fire the Python discovery service to ingest all enabled free lanes (RemoteOK, Workday CXS big-co, amazon.jobs, + registry ATS: greenhouse/lever/ashby/workable/recruitee). `background:true` returns immediately; the service embeds-on-ingest + dedups + resolves trust. Keyed lanes (Fantastic/JSearch/Adzuna) auto-activate when their key env is set. Replaces the old ATS Poller (which wrote rows with no embeddings).
